value.rationale: The experimentally meaningful restriction from local outcomes to partially entangled selected outcomes is absent from the endpoint dichotomy in Du-Zhou-Hu. Two exact all-budget frontiers and incompatible optimizing measurement families answer the nontrivial tradeoff between heralding probability/capacity and conditional extractable work. The inequalities are sharp and motivate resource-aware postselection without pretending to model full implementation cost.
